steps.title: Inspect Error Log
steps.description: Analyze the AAPT resource linking errors in the build log to find incompatible attributes.

steps.title: Identify Invalid Overflow Attribute
steps.description: Locate line 163 of activity_main.xml containing the unsupported 'android:overflow' attribute.

steps.title: Identify Incompatible Stroke Attributes
steps.description: Locate line 435 of activity_main.xml containing invalid stroke attributes on standard LinearLayout layout.

steps.title: Remove Overflow Attribute
steps.description: Strip the 'android:overflow' attribute from the pull-to-refresh header LinearLayout in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Remove Incompatible Stroke Attributes
steps.description: Remove invalid 'android:strokeWidth' and 'android:strokeColor' attributes from the bottom tab bar LinearLayout in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Validate activity_main.xml Layout File
steps.description: Verify the corrected XML layout syntax against standard Android SDK compilation schemas.

steps.title: Retain Application Java Controllers
steps.description: Retain existing high-fidelity Java controllers such as MainActivity, ChartView, and DatabaseHelper.

steps.title: Verify DB and Table Schemas
steps.description: Validate local SQLite database creation and sample data seed queries.

steps.title: Verify AndroidManifest and Assets
steps.description: Validate app package, manifest launcher attributes, and system-default light Material theme configurations.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker Pro
steps.description: Assemble debug package with clean and compatible resource configurations.
